title: Response latency sentinel: per-model/route cohorts with concurrency & IO-mode breakdowns
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a new Sentinel dashboard that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency broken down by model, route, IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming), and request concurrency cohort. This ticket covers schema changes to tracing/metric payloads, metric pipeline transformations, Grafana dashboard panels, and alerting SLI derivation for regression detection.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for each model-route combination (top 50 by volume) over selectable window (5m/1h/24h).
Panels support toggling IO mode: streaming (server-push) vs non-streaming (sync) and show separate percentile series for each mode.
Concurrency cohorting implemented: <1, 1-4, 5-16, >16 in UI with clear legends and drilldown links to traces.
Each panel links to trace examples (via trace_id) and a filtered log pane for the selected cohort and time range.
Metric cardinality kept within SLO: rollup rules applied for low-volume model-routes to avoid explosion in Prometheus/metrics storage.
End-to-end test demonstrating that an injected 200ms tail latency in the streaming path shows up in p99 within 2 minutes on the dashboard and triggers configured regression alert.
Documentation updated: small PR describing new tags (serve_path, model_family, io_mode, concurrency_bucket) and dashboard usage.
All code changes have a peer review and an associated deployment plan for private deployments where metrics topics are customer-managed.
tasks: Add tracing hook: attach serve_path, model_name, model_family, io_mode, request_shape to spans (ENG-110046 will be follow-up for sampling configs)
Emit streaming-specific timing: first-chunk-time, last-chunk-time, total-chunks, chunk-size-median
Update OTEL collector mapping: map span attributes to metrics labels and push to metrics topic (kafka://metrics-redwood) and tracing topic (kafka://traces-redwood)
Prometheus: implement histogram+quantile job for per-model-route latency with label cardinality guards and rollup rules
Loki: add log stream label enrichment for serve_path and io_mode to power log panels
Grafana: design new Sentinel dashboard with grouped heatmap, percentile sparklines, and cohort selector
Alerts: create p99 regression alert (relative + absolute) with runbook link
Add automated integration test that injects synthetic traces/logs and validates panel values via Grafana API
